q: The term 'Biodiversity' was coined by ____ in $1985$ but was popularized by Edward O. Wilson who is now known as 'Father of Biodiversity'.
e: The term 'Biodiversity' was coined by Walter G. Rosen in 1985 but was popularized by Edward O. Wilson who is now known as 'Father of Biodiversity'. Write Walter G. Rosen in the gap.

q: The term 'Biodiversity' was coined by Walter G. Rosen in $1985$ but was popularized by ____ who is now known as 'Father of Biodiversity'.
e: The term 'Biodiversity' was coined by Walter G. Rosen in 1985 but was popularized by Edward O. Wilson who is now known as 'Father of Biodiversity'. The blank is Edward O. Wilson.

q: The term 'Biodiversity' was coined by Walter G. Rosen in $1985$ but was popularized by Edward O. Wilson who is now known as '____'.
e: The term 'Biodiversity' was coined by Walter G. Rosen in 1985 but was popularized by Edward O. Wilson who is now known as 'Father of Biodiversity'. Write Father of Biodiversity in the gap.

q: The term 'Biodiversity' was coined by Walter G. Rosen in ____ but was popularized by Edward O. Wilson who is now known as 'Father of Biodiversity'.
e: The term 'Biodiversity' was coined by Walter G. Rosen in 1985 but was popularized by Edward O. Wilson who is now known as 'Father of Biodiversity'. The blank is 1985.

q: The term 'biodiversity' refers to the variety and variability among living organisms and the ____ complexes in which they occur.
e: The term 'biodiversity' refers to the variety and variability among living organisms and the ecological complexes in which they occur. That missing piece is ecological.

q: Thus, biodiversity can be defined as the totality of genes, species and ____ of a region.
e: Thus, biodiversity can be defined as the totality of genes, species and ecosystem of a region. That missing piece is ecosystem.

q: Biodiversity play a significant role in both human life and the natural ecosystem by maintaining the ____ of the ecosystem.
e: Biodiversity play a significant role in both human life and the natural ecosystem by maintaining the balance of the ecosystem. The blank is balance.

q: Biodiversity can be defined as the degree of ____ of life forms in an ecosystem.
e: Biodiversity can be defined as the degree of variation of life forms in an ecosystem. Write variation in the gap.

q: An ecosystem is a community of organisms and their physical environment ____ each other's together.
e: An ecosystem is a community of organisms and their physical environment interacting each other's together. That missing piece is interacting.

q: The diversity of ecological complexity includes variations in ecological niches, trophic structure, ____ and nutrient cycling etc.
e: The diversity of ecological complexity includes variations in ecological niches, trophic structure, food-webs and nutrient cycling etc. Write food-webs in the gap.

q: The ecosystems also show variations with respect to physical parameters like moisture, temperature, altitude, ____ etc.
e: The ecosystems also show variations with respect to physical parameters like moisture, temperature, altitude, precipitation etc. The blank is precipitation.

q: Species diversity is defined as the number of species and ____ of each species that lives in a particular location.
e: Species diversity is defined as the number of species and abundance of each species that lives in a particular location. The blank is abundance.

q: The number of species in a community is known as species ____.
e: The number of species in a community is known as species richness. Write richness in the gap.

q: Species diversity not only considers richness, but also includes a measure of the ____ of the abundance of the different species.
e: Species diversity not only considers richness, but also includes a measure of the evenness of the abundance of the different species. The blank is evenness.

q: Coral reefs have a very high biodiversity; such an ecosystem offers many different ecological ____, which are exploited by different species.
e: Coral reefs have a very high biodiversity; such an ecosystem offers many different ecological niches, which are exploited by different species. That missing piece is niches.

q: Ecosystems with high species diversity tend to be more stable than ones with limited diversity; they are more able to resist ____.
e: Ecosystems with high species diversity tend to be more stable than ones with limited diversity; they are more able to resist changes. That missing piece is changes.

q: Genetic diversity refers to the variety of genetic information contained in all of the individual plants, animals, fungi and ____.
e: Genetic diversity refers to the variety of genetic information contained in all of the individual plants, animals, fungi and microorganisms. The blank is microorganisms.

q: Genetic diversity is the variety of ____ within a species.
e: Genetic diversity is the variety of genes within a species. Write genes in the gap.

q: The genetic differences between populations of the same species exist because populations may be adapted slightly differences in different parts of their ____.
e: The genetic differences between populations of the same species exist because populations may be adapted slightly differences in different parts of their ranges. Write ranges in the gap.

q: Biodiversity is very important for the well-being of our planet, human health, food security, economy and ____.
e: Biodiversity is very important for the well-being of our planet, human health, food security, economy and livelihoods. The blank is livelihoods.

q: Rich biodiversity allows large-scale ecosystems to function and ____.
e: Rich biodiversity allows large-scale ecosystems to function and self-regulate. That missing piece is self-regulate.

q: Healthy ecosystem and rich biodiversity will increase ecosystem productivity; each species in an ecosystem has a specific ____ which is a role to play.
e: Healthy ecosystem and rich biodiversity will increase ecosystem productivity; each species in an ecosystem has a specific niche which is a role to play. That missing piece is niche.

q: Healthy ecosystem and rich biodiversity will protect ____ water resources.
e: Healthy ecosystem and rich biodiversity will protect fresh water resources. Write fresh in the gap.

q: Healthy ecosystem and rich biodiversity will promote soil formation and ____.
e: Healthy ecosystem and rich biodiversity will promote soil formation and protection. That missing piece is protection.

q: Healthy ecosystem and rich biodiversity will provide nutrient storage and ____.
e: Healthy ecosystem and rich biodiversity will provide nutrient storage and recycling. That missing piece is recycling.

q: Healthy ecosystem and rich biodiversity will aid in breaking down ____.
e: Healthy ecosystem and rich biodiversity will aid in breaking down pollutants. The blank is pollutants.

q: Healthy ecosystem and rich biodiversity will contribute to ____ stability.
e: Healthy ecosystem and rich biodiversity will contribute to climate stability. The blank is climate.

q: Healthy ecosystem and rich biodiversity will speed recovery from natural ____.
e: Healthy ecosystem and rich biodiversity will speed recovery from natural disasters. Write disasters in the gap.
